blockingIssues.description: `python/browser/context.py` still uses synchronous `Camoufox` plus manual `__enter__()`/`__exit__()` management instead of the required `AsyncCamoufox` context-manager pattern.

`python/actions/engagement/follow/highlights_runtime.py` now stores `Locator` instances but still passes them to `page.evaluate()` and `page.wait_for_function()` helpers that expect element-handle-style arguments, which can break highlight watching on real pages.

`python/actions/engagement/follow/posts_runtime.py` collects `Locator` instances and then filters them through `_is_visible()` via `page.evaluate(..., element)`, which can reject or error during the post-like flow.
